create_config.description: Create a config in a product, to keep a group of feature flags in.
create_config.name: create_config

create_flag.description: Create a feature flag (on or off) or a text or number setting in a config. It starts off, or empty, in every environment.
create_flag.name: create_flag

parameters.description: The product the config and environment are in.
parameters.name: product_id

parameters.description: The key code reads it by, such as isNewCheckoutEnabled. It can't be changed later.
parameters.name: key

parameters.description: The kind of value. Leave empty for a feature flag that is on or off.
parameters.name: setting_type

parameters.description: Tags to put on the flag.
parameters.name: tag_ids

schema.description: Tags to put on the flag.

create_segment.description: Create a segment of users whose attribute compares to a value, such as Email contains @example.com.
create_segment.name: create_segment

parameters.description: The user attribute compared, such as Email, Country or a custom one.
parameters.name: attribute

parameters.description: How the attribute compares to the value.
parameters.name: comparator

parameters.description: The value compared with; separate several with commas.
parameters.name: value

create_tag.description: Create a tag for a product's feature flags.
create_tag.name: create_tag

parameters.description: The tag's color, such as panther or salmon, as ConfigCat names them.
parameters.name: color

delete_config.description: Delete a config and every feature flag in it.
delete_config.name: delete_config

parameters.description: The product the config and environment are in.
parameters.name: product_id

delete_flag.description: Delete a feature flag or setting from every environment.
delete_flag.name: delete_flag

parameters.description: The product the config and environment are in.
parameters.name: product_id

delete_segment.description: Delete a segment no targeting rule uses.
delete_segment.name: delete_segment

parameters.description: The product the config and environment are in.
parameters.name: product_id

delete_tag.description: Delete a tag and take it off every flag that has it.
delete_tag.name: delete_tag

parameters.description: The product the config and environment are in.
parameters.name: product_id

get_flag.description: Get a feature flag or setting's key, type, description and tags.
get_flag.name: get_flag

parameters.description: The product the config and environment are in.
parameters.name: product_id

get_flag_value.description: Get a feature flag or setting's value in one environment and how many targeting rules it has.
get_flag_value.name: get_flag_value

parameters.description: The product the config and environment are in.
parameters.name: product_id

get_me.description: Get the name and email address of the account the credentials belong to.
get_me.name: get_me

list_audit_log.description: List what changed in a product and who changed it, optionally for one config, environment or kind of change, over at most 30 days.
list_audit_log.name: list_audit_log

parameters.description: Only changes at or after this time. Leave empty, with Until, for the last 7 days.
parameters.name: since

parameters.description: Which page, starting at 1. Leave empty for the first.
parameters.name: page

parameters.description: How many entries a page holds, up to 100. Leave empty for 100.
parameters.name: page_size

list_configs.description: List a product's configs: the groups its feature flags are kept in.
list_configs.name: list_configs

list_environments.description: List a product's environments, such as Test and Production.
list_environments.name: list_environments

list_flag_values.description: List every feature flag and setting in a config with its value in one environment.
list_flag_values.name: list_flag_values

parameters.description: The product the config and environment are in.
parameters.name: product_id

list_flags.description: List the feature flags and settings in a config, with their type and tags.
list_flags.name: list_flags

parameters.description: The product the config and environment are in.
parameters.name: product_id

list_organizations.description: List the organizations the account belongs to.
list_organizations.name: list_organizations

list_product_members.description: List the people who can open a product, with their permission group.
list_product_members.name: list_product_members

list_products.description: List the products the account can see.
list_products.name: list_products

list_segments.description: List a product's segments: groups of users targeting rules can name.
list_segments.name: list_segments

list_tags.description: List the tags a product's feature flags can carry.
list_tags.name: list_tags

set_flag_value.description: Set a setting's value in one environment: text, a number, or true or false. Its targeting rules stay as they are.
set_flag_value.name: set_flag_value

parameters.description: The product the config and environment are in.
parameters.name: product_id

parameters.description: The value, written as the setting's type: text, a number, or true or false.
parameters.name: value

parameters.description: Why, for the audit log. Needed when the product requires a reason for changes.
parameters.name: reason

switch_flag.description: Turn a feature flag on or off in one environment. Its targeting rules stay as they are.
switch_flag.display_name: Turn feature flag on or off
switch_flag.display_str_template: Turn feature flag on or off.
switch_flag.name: switch_flag

parameters.description: The product the config and environment are in.
parameters.name: product_id

parameters.description: Whether the flag is on in the environment.
parameters.name: enabled

parameters.description: Why, for the audit log. Needed when the product requires a reason for changes.
parameters.name: reason

switch_flag.result_str_template: Turn feature flag on or off completed.

update_flag.description: Rename a feature flag, change its description or replace its tags.
update_flag.name: update_flag

parameters.description: The product the config and environment are in.
parameters.name: product_id

parameters.description: The flag's tags. These replace the tags it has.
parameters.name: tag_ids

schema.description: The flag's tags. These replace the tags it has.

description: Manage ConfigCat feature flags, configs, tags and segments, turn flags on or off and set values per environment, read the audit log, and follow flag changes, new flags and other changes.

configcat_flag_deleted_trigger.description: Runs when a feature flag or setting is deleted.

output.change: The record returned by the service

parameters.description: Only changes in this config. Leave empty for every config.
parameters.name: config_id

configcat_flag_value_changed_trigger.description: Runs when a feature flag is turned on or off, or a setting's value or targeting changes.

output.change: The record returned by the service

parameters.description: Only changes in this config. Leave empty for every config.
parameters.name: config_id

parameters.description: Only changes in this environment. Leave empty for every environment.
parameters.name: environment_id

configcat_new_audit_log_entry_trigger.description: Runs for each new entry in the product's audit log, of the kind you choose.

output.change: The record returned by the service

parameters.description: Only this kind of change, such as settingValueChanged. Leave empty for every kind.
parameters.name: type

configcat_new_flag_trigger.description: Runs when a feature flag or setting is created.

output.change: The record returned by the service

parameters.description: Only changes in this config. Leave empty for every config.
parameters.name: config_id
